limitations: Theorem assumes an algebraically closed characteristic-two field. No statement about tameness, stable tameness, group-scheme structure, or a classification of all characteristic-two involutions. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Every claim of algebraic completeness and normality is proved without relying on finite experiments. The verifier supplies only exact polynomial-identity checks and an exhaustive check of sixteen F2 points. Independent audit has not occurred.
title: A singular normal quotient of the characteristic-two Anick involution
